description:
One currency over time

One currency's rate on every bulletin between `start` and `end` (default: the last 30 days; at most 366 days). Use for how a currency's official rate moved over days or months, e.g. USD/TRY over the last month.

GET /v1/fx/rates/{code} on Currencies (SBX-FX). Costs 1 credit per call.

source.description: `tcmb` (default: Turkish central bank, TRY rates since 2005) or `ecb` (European Central Bank, EUR rates since 1999).

name: fx_getCurrencyHistory
title: Currencies: One currency over time
